crossRefs.note: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white…

translations.web: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
translations.bsb: But whenever raw flesh appears on someone, he will be unclean.
translations.kjv: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
translations.asv: But whensoever raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
